summary_en: This phase 1b study tests the safety, side effects, and best dose of iberdomide given with teclistamab for multiple myeloma that has come back or does not respond to treatment (relapsed or refractory). Teclistamab is given under the skin, and iberdomide is taken by mouth daily on days 1 to 21 starting in cycle 2; cycles repeat every 28 days for up to 4 years if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The study measures safety, side effects, and the best dose, as stated in the brief summary; the primary outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis de iberdomida administrada junto con teclistamab para el mieloma múltiple que ha recidivado o que no responde al tratamiento (recidivante o refractario). Teclistamab se aplica debajo de la piel, e iberdomida se toma por vía oral a diario los días 1 al 21 a partir del ciclo 2; los ciclos se repiten cada 28 días durante hasta 4 años si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis, según indica el resumen breve; la medida de resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Multiple myeloma that has come back or does not respond to treatment.
Disease got worse after at least 4 prior treatment lines, including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory drug, and an anti-CD38 antibody.
Measurable disease by serum or urine M-protein or free light chain levels.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status of 2 or better.
Blood counts, liver tests, and kidney function within the required ranges.
not_for: Active plasma cell leukemia, AL amyloidosis, POEMS syndrome, or Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia.
Prior anti-BCMA directed bispecific antibody therapy.
Prior treatment with a cereblon E3 ligase modulator.
Live vaccine within 30 days, or unresolved toxicity grade 2 or higher from prior treatment.
